name: Popcat
blurb: Oatmeal the cat with a wide "O" mouth, a 2020 meme and a global clicking game
title: Popcat Meme: Meaning, Origin & the Popcat Click Game
description: Popcat is a 2020 meme of Oatmeal the cat opening its mouth into a wide "O"; it became popcat.click, a game where countries compete for clicks.
answer: Popcat is a meme made of two pictures of a cat named Oatmeal: one with its mouth closed and one with its mouth stretched into a wide "O", which together look like the cat is popping or singing. It started in October 2020, when an edit of the photos spread from Reddit to Twitter and the owner posted the original video. In December 2020 it became popcat.click, a game where each click makes the cat pop and adds a point to your country's leaderboard.

body: Oatmeal is a short-haired cat. In the original video it was chirping at a bug; the meme freezes two frames, mouth shut and mouth wide open, and alternates them. Synced to music, it looks like the cat is singing, which earned it the nickname "wide-mouth singing cat".

body.note: The open-mouth image is an edit: the owner shared a normal photo and an edited one with the mouth stretched open before the meme took off.

head: Date
Event
rows: A friend of Oatmeal's owner posts the two-frame edit as a GIF on Reddit's r/MEOW_IRL.
A Twitter repost passes a million views.
The owner uploads the original video of Oatmeal chirping at a bug; lip-sync edits spread on Instagram and iFunny.
Three University of Sheffield students launch popcat.click, a clicker game with a country leaderboard.
The game goes viral again across Asia and Europe; Taiwan takes the top spot in August 2021.

ul: Music edits where Oatmeal "sings" along to songs by opening and closing its mouth.
Four-panel memes where cartoon characters copy the cat's two expressions.
Clicking popcat.click for hours to push one's country up the leaderboard; some schools in Finland banned it in 2021.
Copycat clicker sites that swap the cat for other faces or animals.

body: Popcat is a classic from the pandemic era. The game is still online, and as of August 2023 its board listed 237 regions, with Hong Kong, Taiwan and Thailand at the top. The meme itself shows up mostly as a reaction GIF now.

faq.q: What is the Popcat cat's name?
faq.a: Oatmeal. It belongs to a Twitter user who first shared the photos with friends on Discord.
A browser game from December 2020: every click makes the cat pop and adds one to your country's total on a global leaderboard.

faq.q: Why does the cat's mouth look so big?
faq.a: The open-mouth frame is an edited photo; the original video showed Oatmeal chirping at a bug.
